CHAMBER ACTION & COMBAT CONTROLS
WASD / ↑↓←→

Tactical Movement & Push

Navigate Lolo 1 tile in cardinal directions. Pushes obstacles (metal blocks, emerald prisms, and enemy egg shells) along unobstructed floors.

SPACE / X

Plasma Stasis Blaster

Fires a high-energy plasma projectile. 1st Shot: Encases hostile into a pushable crystalline egg. 2nd Shot: Disintegrates egg into particles.

Z

Temporal Rewind (Undo)

Instantly rewinds time by 1 move. Restores Lolo's position, enemy states, egg timers, and ammo cells with zero score penalty. Unlimited multi-step history!

R

Chamber Reset (Restart)

Reinitializes the current chamber from orbit with a vertical teleportation laser beam. Use when trapped or testing new puzzle trajectories.

H

Holographic Ghost Guide & Path Trace (AI Solver)

Toggles the in-engine AI mathematical solver. Materializes an interconnected neon cyber-conduit breadcrumb path with directional chevrons and a translucent, chromatic-aberration ghost operative running the optimal solution in real time.

THE 4 GOLDEN INFILTRATION DIRECTIVES
1 HARVEST QUANTUM HEART EMITTERS

Infiltrate the chamber and collect all glowing quantum power cells. Some emitters contain +2 Stasis Blaster Ammo charges. Monitor your tactical ammo HUD!

2 EXTRACT THE JEWEL CYBER CORE

When the final Heart Emitter is harvested, the central Jewel Chest automatically unlocks. Touch the chest to retrieve the sector security key and deactivate chamber lockdown.

3 EXFILTRATE QUANTUM GATE

With the Cyber Core secured, the reinforced exit door at the north perimeter unseals and glows bright cyan. Step into the gate to warp to the next challenge!

4 MASTER ENEMY EGG MECHANICS

Shooting an enemy turns them into an egg. Push eggs to block laser sightlines, hold pressure plates, or push into water to form bridges or floating rafts!

ENEMY EGG PHYSICS & RESPAWN LAWS

  • Egg Shell Duration: Encapsulated enemies remain in egg form for a set duration before cracking open.
  • Double Shot Disintegration: Shooting an egg a 2nd time vaporizes it from the board. It will respawn at its starting coordinates after 5 seconds.
  • Water Bridges: Pushing an egg into a 1-tile water canal sinks it to form a permanent crossing bridge.
  • Deep Water Rafting: Pushing an egg into wide water creates a buoyant floating raft that follows water currents. Step aboard and ride it!

Serpent Drone (Snakey)

DOCILE

Stationary bio-synthetic sentinel. Completely harmless upon contact. Prime candidate for egg encapsulation to construct shields, bridges, and mobile rafts.

Golgotha Skull (Gol)

LETHAL FIRE

Remains asleep while Heart Emitters exist on the grid. Once the final emitter is gathered, Gol awakens and launches lethal fireballs down straight sightlines!

Medusa Sentry

INSTANT KILL

Fixed laser turret with continuous 4-way cardinal line-of-sight tracking (N/S/E/W). Stepping into view without a blocking wall or block results in instant annihilation!

Diagonal Medusa

45° LASER

Projects purple 45-degree angle lasers slicing diagonally across the chamber. Must be blocked by positioning obstacles diagonally or deflecting with prisms.

Centaur Raider (Leeper)

PURSUIT

Aggressively charges toward Lolo at double speed. When it reaches Lolo, it falls asleep permanently, turning into an immovable solid stone obstacle!

Apex Titan (Don Medusa)

APEX BOSS

Patrols along a fixed axis continuously while scanning for operative line-of-sight with instant-kill laser tracking. Time your crossings when shielded or when it turns away!

Doppelgänger (Mirror)

MIRROR

Mirrors Lolo's exact movement vectors. Pushes alloy blocks and triggers remote pressure plates to unlock security doors.

Tesla Sentinel

EMP ARC

Projects an electrical arc along its lane. Striking water electrifies the entire moat! Sever the beam with blocks or eggs.

Magnetron Drone

GRAVITY

Emits periodic magnetic tractor pulses that pull or push alloy blocks along its corridor, shifting puzzle layouts.

Phase Weaver

QUANTUM

Quantum-teleports across open floor tiles every few moves. Functions as dynamic, moving cover against Medusa lasers.

Stealth Specter

CLOAKED

Cloaked predator (90% invisible). Track its ripples in water/lava, footprints in slime, or laser interruptions!

FLUID WAVE DYNAMICS & CURRENTS

Liquid surfaces utilize a real-time discrete 2D wave propagation engine with caustic reflections. Pushing blocks or egg rafts into water creates expanding shockwaves. Floating rafts drift in the direction of the river flow.

MOLTEN MAGMA & BASALT CRUSTS

High-heat liquid lava emits orange-yellow point lighting and convection embers. Disturbing magma cracks the cooling crust to reveal glowing molten fissures. Pushing stone blocks into lava creates basalt bridges.

QUANTUM WARP PORTALS

Stepping into Quantum Portal Alpha instantly materializes Lolo at Portal Beta across the grid, allowing traversal through sealed security enclosures and isolated islands.

ONE-WAY DIRECTIONAL ARROWS

Directional energy corridors that permit movement only in the arrow's orientation. Operative and pushed blocks cannot travel backwards against the energy field!

PRESSURE PLATES & LASER GATES

Dual-channel logic (Cyan & Magenta). Weigh down a plate with Lolo, blocks, or encased eggs to disarm armed laser gates across the room!

BLINK / PHASE RHYTHM FLOORS

Alternates rhythmically between solid ground and empty abyss. Watch the perimeter countdown ring! De-phasing while standing on it disintegrates operative into the abyss.

SHATTER-GLASS CRACKING PANELS

High-tension glass floor tiles. Cracks on the 1st step; completely collapses into a water pit on the 2nd step, enforcing strict one-way puzzle routes.

WEAPON TURRET SOCKETS

Heavy titanium circular mounts. Pushing an encased enemy egg onto the socket locks it into place, converting it into an automated defense cannon firing plasma bolts down its lane!

CROSS-SYSTEM ELEMENTAL SYNERGIES

Thermal Slime: Explosions or plasma fire ignite Nanite Sludge, burning it away into clean floor! • Electrified Water: Tesla arcs striking liquid electrify connected pools until severed. • Raft Hijacking: Almas and Skulls can step onto floating egg rafts to traverse water moats!

HALF-TILE MEDUSA SLIP

Medusa's instant-kill laser only triggers when Lolo's center axis aligns directly with the Medusa's tile. By nudging half a tile behind an obstacle, you can slip past laser corridors safely!

CURRENT SURFING ON EGG RAFTS

When you push an egg into wide rivers, it transforms into an egg raft that drifts downstream. Step aboard, ride the current across the lake, and step onto the shore before it sinks!

AI GHOST SOLVER RUNNER (KEY H)

Stuck on a diabolical puzzle? Press H to summon the Holographic AI Ghost Operative. It walks and demonstrates the mathematical shortest path in real time.

ZERO-PENALTY REWIND (KEY Z)

Never fear testing dangerous moves! Press Z anytime to step back in time. Unlimited multi-step undo allows bold experimentation without resetting.
